description: This file defines classes related to configuring and validating persistent stream storage in the Orleans framework, including the PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator and SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator classes.

classes.name: PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator
classes.description: Validates stream pub/sub configuration options to ensure necessary grain storage providers are configured for stream pub/sub types.

methods.name: PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing validator with service provider and stream provider name.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates if the required grain storage is configured for the specified stream provider based on pub/sub type.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures persistent streaming in an Orleans silo, setting up necessary components and services.

methods.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configurator with stream provider name, configuration delegate, and adapter factory.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the grain storage provider is properly configured for the stream provider before deployment.
